L01.text: Could your basement be a home? For your mom, for a grown kid, or a rental that helps with the mortgage.

L02.text: In Ontario, zoning can't ban up to three homes on a serviced lot. But the first answer is the hard part.

L03.text: The rules are spread across the Building Code, the Fire Code and city by-laws. And permit drawings alone can cost thousands, before anyone knows if it can work.

L04.text: Basement Ready starts with your phone. Film your basement once, walking slowly through each room.

L05.text: Then Meta's models go to work.

L06.text: SAM 3.1 finds and tracks the windows, doors, stairs, ducts and beams, through the whole video.

L07.text: MapAnything turns that ordinary video into depth, so every wall, ceiling and window is measured. No LiDAR needed.

L08.text: Muse Wonder watches the whole take and names the rooms. Muse Spark checks the finds against the Ontario Building Code, and it can only claim what the video shows.

L09.text: While it measures, the guide asks only what it can't see, and tells you why it's asking.

L11.text: This basement in Waterloo can be a second home after one fix: a fire separation between the two homes. It's marked on the measured plan, with a rough cost, and a source for every rule.

L12.text: It finds the money that fits: a federal tax credit, a city grant and the Region's forgivable loan, each with how to apply.

L13.text: Not sure what a fire separation is? Ask, and it draws it for you.

L14.text: Next, design it. Check that the plan is your basement, and fix any wall right on the drawing.

L15.text: Pick a layout that keeps the stairs, the furnace and the window where they are, and look around it in 3D.

L16.text: Muse Image restyles your own frames in the look you picked: your basement, before and after, labelled virtually staged.

L17.text: Then, build it. The permit set is drawn and filled in from the scan, and it shows how much is ready.

L18.text: The guide asks only for what it can't measure, like a few tape numbers and who owns the house.

L19.text: Then the money to apply for, and registered designers and trades to ask for quotes, all in one book you can hand to a designer.

L20.text: Your scan is private, and nothing is sent without you. It screens; the city decides, and a designer confirms the details.
